# Consent sign-in

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P3 · Act as the user](../README.md#phase-3--act-as-the-user) · **Lane:** Identity provider · **Label:** `feature:consent-auth` · **Epic:** [#127](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/127) · **Tickets:** 4 (3S 1M)

Employees sign in to the consent portal on the CP with their Dex identity, using a session type separate from the admin console and with no console privileges. The login requests offline_access so the CP holds each user's Dex refresh token, which offboarding later uses to detect disabled users.

## How we build it

- Separate OIDC client registration (config consent.oidc: issuer, clientID, clientSecretEnv, redirectURL=/portal/callback, scopes [openid,email,profile,groups,offline_access]) reusing the generic OIDC client code from p1-sso-roles; no Dex-specific calls.
- Session type portal: cookie __Host-warden_portal (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/), server-side row in CP SQLite table portal_sessions(id_hash, sub, email, created_at, expires_at, last_seen_at); idle timeout consent.session.idle (default 30m), absolute lifetime consent.session.max (default 8h). Portal sessions are rejected by all /dashboard/api/* handlers and vice versa.
- Dex refresh token stored in the secret backend at warden/users/<sub>/_idp (never in SQLite); table idp_links(sub, email, refresh_ref, linked_at, last_refresh_at, last_refresh_status) holds only a Reference.
- CSRF: double-submit token bound to the session (X-CSRF-Token header required on every non-GET /portal/api/* call); auth code flow uses state + nonce + PKCE S256 with a 10-minute pending login record.
- Logout deletes the session row; it does not delete the stored refresh token (offboarding still needs it).

## Done when

An employee in Dex can sign in at /portal, gets a portal session that cannot call any console API, and their Dex refresh token is in the secret backend at warden/users/<sub>/_idp.

### 1/4 · W-P3-CSIG-01

**Add consent.oidc config block and portal OIDC client**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#128](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/128)

Add a consent block to internal/config (oidc.issuer, oidc.clientID, oidc.clientSecretEnv, oidc.redirectURL, session.idle, session.max) with validation, strict-field registration and EncodeNode support like secretstore.go. Construct a second instance of the generic OIDC client from p1-sso-roles with scopes openid email profile groups offline_access. The block is CP-local and never on the policy wire.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A config with the consent block parses and validates; missing issuer or clientID fails with a clear error
- [ ] clientSecretEnv resolves from the environment; the secret is never logged
- [ ] The block does not appear in GET /policy output

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-CSIG-02`](consent-auth.md#24--w-p3-csig-02) Implement portal login, callback and session store; [`W-P3-BRKR-01`](oauth-broker.md#15--w-p3-brkr-01) Add provider config model with Google and GitHub defaults

### 2/4 · W-P3-CSIG-02

**Implement portal login, callback and session store**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#129](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/129)

New package internal/portal with handlers GET /portal/login (state, nonce, PKCE S256, pending login row, 10m TTL) and GET /portal/callback (exchange code, verify ID token iss/aud/exp/nonce, create portal_sessions row, set __Host-warden_portal cookie). Migration adds portal_sessions in CP SQLite; session IDs are 32 random bytes stored as SHA-256. Mount under the CP mux in controlplane.go when the consent block is configured.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Login against Dex (test/fakes OIDC) sets a portal cookie and redirects to /portal
- [ ] A replayed or unknown state returns 400 and creates no session
- [ ] Session expires after the idle timeout and after the absolute lifetime

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-CSIG-01`](consent-auth.md#14--w-p3-csig-01) Add consent.oidc config block and portal OIDC client

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-CSIG-03`](consent-auth.md#34--w-p3-csig-03) Store Dex refresh token in the secret backend on login; [`W-P3-CSIG-04`](consent-auth.md#44--w-p3-csig-04) Add CSRF protection and session isolation from console

### 3/4 · W-P3-CSIG-03

**Store Dex refresh token in the secret backend on login**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#130](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/130)

In the portal callback, write the refresh token via the CP's SecretStore.Put to warden/users/<sub>/_idp and upsert idp_links(sub, email, refresh_ref=secrets.Ref(token).String(), linked_at). If no writable secret backend is configured or offline_access was not granted, refuse login with an explicit error page since offboarding would be impossible. Never log the token, only its Reference.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] After login the echo/AWS fake store holds key warden/users/<sub>/_idp
- [ ] idp_links holds a Reference, and a reflect test confirms no value-bearing column
- [ ] A login without a refresh token in the response fails with a 500 page naming offline_access

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-CSIG-02`](consent-auth.md#24--w-p3-csig-02) Implement portal login, callback and session store

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-OFFB-02`](offboarding.md#24--w-p3-offb-02) Add periodic Dex refresh job with failure classification

### 4/4 · W-P3-CSIG-04

**Add CSRF protection and session isolation from console**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#131](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/131)

Add portal middleware that loads the session, enforces idle/absolute expiry, and requires a session-bound X-CSRF-Token on non-GET /portal/api/* requests (token served via GET /portal/api/me). Make the console auth middleware reject portal cookies and the portal middleware reject console sessions, worker tokens and API keys. Add POST /portal/logout.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A POST to /portal/api/* without a matching CSRF token returns 403
- [ ] A portal cookie on /dashboard/api/policy returns 401
- [ ] Logout invalidates the session row and the cookie no longer authenticates

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-CSIG-02`](consent-auth.md#24--w-p3-csig-02) Implement portal login, callback and session store

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-BRKR-03`](oauth-broker.md#35--w-p3-brkr-03) Implement /connect/start with PKCE and agent scope capping
